children: ETHGas will unlock 510 million GWEI on January 21, 2027. The tokens are allocated to advisors, investors and the team, and the unlock will increase circulating supply by 25.27%.
Once the lock expires, recipients can sell tokens that were previously restricted. The size of the release is expected to create strong sell pressure as that supply becomes available to trade.

title: ETHGas: 510 million GWEI tokens unlock for advisors, investors and team - 21 Jan 2027
